Vitamins and Minerals
Patients with IBD are at higher risk for vitamin, mineral, and trace element deficiencies. Higher 
doses of specific nutrients are indicated if clinical or laboratory evidence identifies a deficiency due 
to possible poor absorption or increased requirements. Vitamin and mineral requirements for 
patients with IBD are described here and summarized in Table 7-9.
